mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE perm_id = #{permId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_group_permission gp ON p.perm_id = gp.perm_id JOIN sys_user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id JOIN sys_group g ON ug.group_id = g.group_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.perm_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_group_permission gp ON p.perm_id = gp.perm_id JOIN sys_user_group ug ON gp.group_id = ug.group_id JOIN sys_group g ON ug.group_id = g.group_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (perm_name, perm_code, perm_type, parent_id, path, component, icon, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{permName}, #{permCode}, #{permType}, #{parentId}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET perm_name = #{permName}, perm_code = #{permCode}, perm_type = #{permType}, parent_id = #{parentId}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE perm_id = #{permId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_permission SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE perm_id = #{permId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_group_permission WHERE perm_id = #{permId}
